items.title: Senior AML Investigator
items.description: ABOUT POLYMARKET Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future. We're growing fast, both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire. ABOUT THE ROLE Polymarket US operates under CFTC oversight as a regulated prediction market, which means the compliance function carries real regulatory weight. The AML team is responsible for detecting and reporting suspicious activity across a user base that transacts through card, ACH and stablecoin rails, and the work requires both financial crime expertise and the ability to think clearly about a product that looks different from a traditional bank or broker. The team is small and the caseload is real. This hire matters because investigation quality is the core of what we do. You will own your casework, from initial review through SAR filing or documented declination, and your judgment will directly shape how the program holds up to regulatory scrutiny. You will also be a resource for the analysts around you, which means your standards become their standards. The environment moves fast. Polymarket is growing, the regulatory landscape for prediction markets is still developing, and the compliance program is being built to match that pace. If you want a role where the work is clearly defined and the edge cases are rare, this is not it. If you want to do serious investigative work at a company where compliance has a seat at the table, it is. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Investigate escalated cases from transaction monitoring, fraud referrals, market surveillance and sanctions screening for signs of money laundering, terrorist financing, fraud and sanctions evasion. - Analyze funding, withdrawal and trading patterns across card, ACH and stablecoin rails, including linked account activity, to build a clear picture of what a customer is doing and why. - Prepare detailed Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) that meet regulatory requirements and internal policy, and document decisions when no SAR is needed. - Review customer identity and profile information to assess whether activity fits the customer's known background and stated purpose. - Support law enforcement requests, subpoenas and 314(a) reviews. - Perform quality control reviews of analyst work and provide direct, actionable feedback as needed. - Help analysts work through complex cases, and develop job aids and training materials that raise the baseline quality of the team's output. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 4 or more years of hands-on AML investigation experience, including writing SARs that have been filed with FinCEN. - Strong working knowledge of the Bank Secrecy Act, SAR filing requirements and core AML regulations. - Demonstrated ability to analyze transaction activity across multiple payment rails and draw well-supported conclusions about the nature of that activity. - Clear written communication, specifically the ability to write SAR narratives that are accurate, organized and defensible. - Experience with investigative research tools such as CLEAR or LexisNexis, and with case management systems. - A track record of managing a caseload independently, meeting deadlines and maintaining quality under volume. - (Plus) Experience with blockchain analytics tools (such as Chainalysis, TRM or Elliptic) and on-chain tracing. - (Plus) Experience at an exchange, FCM, broker-dealer, prediction market, or sports betting or gaming operator. - (Plus) Familiarity with CFTC or NFA rules, or with derivatives and event contracts. - (Plus) Experience applying AI tools to investigation workflows, or a clear interest in doing so. - (Plus) CAMS certification or equivalent. BENEFITS - Competitive salary & equity - Unlimited PTO - Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage - 401k match - Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories

items.title: Quant Risk Analyst - Derivatives & Clearing
items.description: ABOUT POLYMARKET Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform, where people trade on the outcomes of real-world events. As our markets, volumes, and derivative product suite grow, so does the sophistication of the risk infrastructure behind them. Our clearing and risk systems must operate with the rigor of a traditional clearinghouse while moving at the speed of a crypto-native trading platform. THE ROLE We're hiring a mid-level quantitative risk analyst to design and implement enterprise-scale risk models at the heart of our clearing operation. You'll own models for market risk, volatility and correlation of derivatives, stress testing, and automated liquidation — the systems that keep the platform solvent and users protected in fast-moving markets. This is a hands-on role: you'll be building models in production code, not just specifying them. We expect you to work fluently with AI tools for development and research — and to be the skeptic in the room, pressure-testing AI-generated models and code against well-established risk frameworks before anything ships. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Design, implement, and maintain enterprise-scale risk models covering market risk, margin, and counterparty exposure for a clearing organization. - Build volatility and correlation models for derivatives, including calibration, backtesting, and ongoing model validation. - Develop and run stress-testing frameworks: historical scenarios, hypothetical shocks, and reverse stress tests. - Design and tune auto-liquidation logic — trigger thresholds, liquidation waterfalls, and safeguards against cascading liquidations. - Use AI tools extensively to accelerate model development, coding, and research — and rigorously validate AI outputs against established risk models (VaR/ES, SPAN-style margining, GARCH-family volatility models, standard correlation frameworks) before deployment. - Monitor model performance in production, investigate breaks, and iterate quickly. - Partner with engineering, trading, and product teams to embed risk controls into platform architecture. - Document model assumptions, limitations, and validation results to an audit-ready standard. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 5–7 years of quantitative risk experience at a clearinghouse, exchange, prime broker, trading firm, or similar. - Proven expertise designing and implementing risk models at enterprise scale — production systems, not just research prototypes. - Deep experience modeling volatility, correlation, option skews, option pricing and implementing at scale for trad-fi derivatives, perpetuals, and fully collateralized event contracts. - Hands-on experience with market risk modeling, stress testing, and auto-liquidation mechanics in a clearing context. - Strong fluency with AI-assisted development and coding, paired with the judgment to pressure-test AI outputs against well-established risk models and catch what looks plausible but is wrong. - Expert-level Python (numerical stack: NumPy, pandas, SciPy; solid software engineering practices). - Advanced degree in a quantitative field (math, statistics, physics, financial engineering, CS) or equivalent experience. - Strong mathematical foundation in stochastic calculus and linear algebra. NICE TO HAVE - C# and/or C++ for performance-critical or production systems. - Familiarity with crypto market structure, perpetuals, or prediction markets. - Experience with CCP risk frameworks (CPMI-IOSCO PFMI, default management, margin methodology). - Experience building real-time risk systems. PAY TRANSPARENCY Base salary range: $400,000 to $450,000, plus equity and benefits. This is a good-faith range for the level we're hiring at. Experience varies widely within a title here, so if your expectations fall outside it, reach out anyway. We're always happy to talk it through. LOCATION & WORK SETUP This role is based in our New York City office, in person. You'll be working directly alongside the trading, engineering, and risk teams.

items.location_text: Paris, Palo Alto, Amsterdam, Linz, Munich, London, Berlin
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE TEAM You will join the AI4Engineering Science team, the Mistral research group that builds the data and evaluation infrastructure and owns the SFT/RL processes for AI4Engineering that teach our frontier LLMs to do real engineering work. The agentic engineering group works alongside the Physics AI research in the wider Science organisation. This seat sits in the agentic CAD stream. Together with the Solutions and Applied teams, the group carries this work into customer projects with industrial partners in automotive, aerospace, semiconductors, and beyond. THE ROLE Mistral is looking for an AI Scientist with deep machine learning expertise and hands-on CAD experience to expand what our agentic tools can do for computer-aided design. Your focus is a single mission: teaching Mistral's LLMs to generate, analyze, and modify CAD designs the way an expert design engineer would. Your core work is building the pre- and post-training data for Mistral's LLMs to reason about and execute real CAD tasks: text-to-CAD and image-to-CAD generation from technical drawings, geometric analysis and QA of CAD parts, and modification of existing designs. Because Mistral trains its own frontier LLMs, the data and verifiers you design ship directly into models you can hold - a rare position, and the core of the job. Alongside this, you will help shape the agent architectures and harnesses that let these models operate reliably inside multi-step CAD workflows, driving CAD tools through APIs or computer use across the whole design loop. This is early-stage work, and that's the point: you are joining at the foundation, shaping the data, verifiers, and agent scaffolding that decide whether these systems become reliable or stay demo-grade. There is no inherited playbook; you will help define what good looks like, and your work will set the direction the CAD stream builds on rather than extend an existing one. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Design pretraining, SFT, and RL data for CAD tasks: text-to-CAD and image-to-CAD generation from technical drawings, geometric analysis and QA of CAD parts, and design modification - Define verifiers and evaluation criteria that capture what "correct" and "high-quality" actually mean for CAD tasks - Scale the data pipelines that produce agentic CAD training traces - Design and improve agent architectures and harnesses: how models plan, call CAD tools via API or computer use, recover from errors, and chain steps together across long-horizon design workflows - Build and maintain CAD evaluation benchmarks and diagnostic tooling, from parametric CAD and drawing-to-3D benchmarks to industrial evaluations, identifying where models fail and tracing those failures back to gaps in data, reward design, or agent scaffolding - Collaborate with CAD domain experts and the CAE and EDA streams (and the science and solutions teams more broadly) to identify which CAD workflows are highest-value to target next - Contribute to Mistral's broader pre- and post-training research, sharing findings and methodology across the science organization WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Deep, hands-on machine learning expertise, particularly LLM development: you have built LLM training pipelines (SFT, RL, fine-tuning, GRPO), demonstrated in publications or shipped systems rather than CV claims - Demonstrated hands-on CAD experience: you have designed, scripted, or automated real CAD workflows in tools such as SolidWorks, CATIA, Siemens NX, FreeCAD, or CADQuery, ideally with CAD-kernel grounding (OpenCASCADE, build123d) - Fluent English with excellent communication skills: you can explain technical ML and CAD concepts to both engineering and non-technical audiences - You write clean, readable Python code and are comfortable in Linux/HPC environments - Self-directed: you do not need detailed roadmaps to make progress - Low-ego, collaborative, and eager to learn at the intersection of CAD and ML It would be great if you: - Have experience building or fine-tuning agentic systems (tool use, multi-step planning, agent orchestration frameworks) - Have experience with reward modeling, RLHF/RLAIF/RLVR, or preference-based training - Have first-author publications or open-source benchmark work in agentic CAD or CAD-ML, such as CAD generation benchmarks or RL/GRPO fine-tuning of vision-language models for CAD - Have contributed to a large open-source or industry codebase - Have publications in engineering and ML venues (NeurIPS, ICLR, ICCV, SIGGRAPH, JFM, AIAA, etc.) WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.title: Product Manager
items.description: Betable Group are experts in the iGaming and Fintech markets, specialising in both casino operations and technology. As part of our continued growth, we have recently launched our latest gaming and fintech products and are now looking for a Product Manager to join our rapidly expanding team. You will have the chance to make a tangible impact, helping to build and refine a product that delivers exceptional value to customers while supporting the company's strategic ambitions. Working closely with stakeholders across the business, you will be responsible for driving product direction, identifying opportunities for innovation and ensuring the product continues to meet user needs while staying ahead of market trends, customer expectations and regulatory requirements. Whilst previous iGaming experience is advantageous, we are looking for someone who is excited by the industry, commercially aware and eager to learn. The ideal candidate will be forward-thinking, highly organised and detail-oriented, with a willingness to contribute at every level. We value Product Managers who are hands-on, curious and passionate about their craft, whether that's contributing to product strategy, getting into delivery detail, analysing customer insights or collaborating with teams to solve complex problems. At Betable Group, we actively encourage involvement in the wider product community. We look for individuals who stay engaged with industry trends, share ideas and insights and contribute to the profession through channels such as LinkedIn, product forums, conferences and meetups. With a team based in Manchester, we support attendance at product networking events, community meetups and online discussions as part of our commitment to continuous learning and professional development. This is a unique opportunity for an ambitious Product Manager to help define the future of a growing product, influence strategic decisions and develop their career within a fast-paced and innovative business. • Develop and articulate a clear vision for the gaming product, aligned with the company's overall strategic objectives. Identify market opportunities and define product roadmap priorities based on customer feedback, industry trends and competitive analysis. • Demonstrates a strong product mindset, with curiosity about the why behind customer needs, business problems and product opportunities. Understands the fundamentals of UX and UI, with strong attention to detail and an appreciation for creating simple, intuitive customer experiences. • Is highly proficient in Jira, comfortable managing backlogs, creating well-defined tickets, prioritising work and supporting development teams through delivery. Uses customer feedback, research, analytics and experimentation to understand problems, validate ideas and improve products. • Works effectively with Product Designers, Developers and other stakeholders within cross-functional teams. • Working with our Compliance team to consider all legal and regulatory requirements in relevant jurisdictions, ensuring applicable laws and industry standards for responsible gambling and data protection are considered. • Is comfortable translating customer and business problems into clear product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria. • Can confidently participate in discovery, planning, refinement, release management & product go live support. • Thrives in a fast-moving environment, learning quickly and adapting when priorities change. • Takes ownership of their work, follows problems through to resolution and understands that shipping the feature is not the end of the product lifecycle. • Is commercially curious and developing an understanding of how product decisions contribute to customer value and business outcomes. • Brings a hands-on, collaborative attitude, willing to get into the detail while developing their product management craft. • Champion the user experience by defining intuitive workflows, designing engaging interfaces, and optimising customer journeys to maximise user satisfaction, retention and lifetime value. Experience as a product owner or product manager. • Experience across digital products on web and mobile platforms. • Experience working with customer feedback, analytics, research and experimentation to drive decision-making. • Strong analytical mindset and data-driven decision-making abilities. • Knowledge of agile software development methodologies, such as Scrum or Kanban and experience working with project management tools such as Clickup. • Organised, the ability to manage multiple priorities across various platforms. • Questions everything, leaves no assumptions • Experienced managing admin configuration tools and user frontend experience • Champions product thinking within the business. • Experience in building out integrations across platforms. • Ability to vibe design features to ensure design gates can be closed. • Always thinking how AI application could impact new features. • Self-starter, focused on delivery and metrics over features deployed. • Interested in iGaming and Gambling products. • Research driven innovator, someone who delves into the player psychology and data modelling

items.title: Senior Data Center Pre-Construction and Capacity Delivery Manager, EMEA
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About Anthropic Anthropic's mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As a Senior Data Center Preconstruction & Capacity Delivery Manager at Anthropic, you'll make sure our EMEA deals are ready to execute before we commit to them, and you'll take time out of every program before the lease is signed. Delivery dates and costs on AI infrastructure deals are largely fixed at signature. What is missed before then is hard to recover afterwards, and our leverage over the schedule is at its highest while the deal is still open. About 75% of your time goes to preconstruction and pre-lease management, from first desktop review through Letter of Intent (LOI) to lease execution. You'll test whether each opportunity can be delivered, rigorously accelerate its program, and shape the deal so that what a developer commits to can be held to, verified and delivered. The other 25% goes to delivery. You'll carry that work through mobilization, embed with the partners building leased and partnered capacity, and lead them to deliver on the fastest possible schedule while maintaining a safe construction site and protecting the finished quality of the data center. Our EMEA pipeline is getting off the ground, so you'll set the standard for how deals become ready for execution here. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape how Anthropic secures and activates the compute infrastructure needed to train and deploy frontier AI systems, working at the intersection of real estate, construction, and cutting-edge AI infrastructure. Responsibilities - preconstruction and pre-lease management (about 75%): Lead. This is a role where leadership trumps management and process. You will be expected to engage developers, contractors, utilities and our transaction teams early enough to shape the outcome of each deal rather than report on it afterwards. Confirm deal readiness and serve as the gatekeeper to validate transaction viability from LOI through lease execution, ensuring all predevelopment, planning, technical and business requirements are met before commitment Give transaction leads an early delivery view from desktop study on capacity, power, permitting, connectivity, schedule and cost, so that the sites moving to LOI are ones that can be delivered Run independent, evidence-based delivery due diligence on each opportunity, tested against source documents rather than relayed claims, covering capacity, power, permitting, connectivity, procurement, schedule, cost, and whether the developer's team, contractors and supply chain can deliver Interrogate every developer schedule from the native file rather than summary dates, testing logic, durations, production rates and critical paths, planning backwards from commissioning, and establishing the unconstrained date before any commercial protection is added Rigorously accelerate programs during the pre-lease phase by making schedule work a priority for the developer while the deal depends on it, pulling forward design, permitting, power, early works and procurement, and sequencing the build around how capacity turns up Assess contractor and supply-chain capacity and long-lead equipment needs for each opportunity, setting a long-lead strategy that secures delivery capacity ahead of need and making the case for early equipment funding where it protects a date Challenge Total Development Cost and delivery schedules against the assumptions behind Yield-on-Cost and IRR, flagging where time-to-power or cost exposure puts the investment case at risk Shape the delivery terms of the LOI, lease and supporting exhibits with transaction and legal teams, including phasing and target dates, landlord scope, diligence cost, ownership and reliance, risk allocation and governance, and check that the developer's contract with its general contractor carries the same milestones and aligns incentives around accelerated delivery Give deal and delivery leadership a clear go/no-go recommendation at each decision point up to signature, with the risks, conditions and mitigations behind it Keep one delivery-readiness record and one risk register across all EMEA opportunities, assigning every risk to an accountable owner, tracking it to resolution, and escalating where cost or schedule is threatened Direct owner's representatives and third-party advisers and assure what they produce, bringing design and engineering, cost, schedule, commercial, contracts and procurement into a single view of risk and readiness Develop and refine the preconstruction playbook, a reference log of unit costs and benchmarks, and the operating model needed to scale the function, using AI tools including Claude for first-pass assessment, document review and benchmarking so your time goes to judgment and negotiation Prepare and present regular executive reporting on readiness and risk for each opportunity and across the portfolio, including time from signature to construction start, risks found before versus after signature, and baseline-to-actual variance, supporting forward capacity planning and strategic decision-making Responsibilities - delivery leadership (about 25%): Document the baseline at signature for design, budget, schedule, long-lead position, open risks and conditions, so delivery starts from an assured position whether you carry the project forward yourself or hand it to a delivery colleague Partner with landlords and developers post-deal to serve as Anthropic's primary point of contact, coordinating across internal stakeholders, tracking construction progress, and facilitating critical information exchange between development partners and Anthropic stakeholders You will be expected to be at one or more project sites in adequate amount to shape the culture, approach, and aggressiveness that define those extended site teams. The goal is to impact outcomes in a favorable manner. You are expected to be a force multiplier that develops and enhances the skillset that development partners, contractors, and key trades bring to the project(s) you are overseeing. That means being a subject matter expert in the various cross functional elements of data center delivery and increasing the team's performance with that knowledge and commitment to alignment. Represent Anthropic in key technical and operational decisions required by partners during the development process, ensuring our infrastructure requirements are met while maintaining strong partnerships Drive seamless handoffs to operational state with heavy focus on engagement across networking and deployment teams, enabling rapid workload turn-ups and minimizing time-to-production Identify and mitigate risks throughout the delivery lifecycle, proactively addressing blockers that could impact timeline, cost, or technical requirements, and feed what you learn on site back into diligence and the playbook You may be a good fit if you: Have 8+ years of experience in preconstruction, development, or cost and commercial management on data center or other large mission-critical programs within EMEA, including time leading delivery on site. You won't have a big direct team to delegate to but will instead be able to treat the entire cross functional organizations around each deal and jobsite as your team. Have a track record of testing developer and contractor claims on cost, schedule, power and permitting against source documents, and of telling a deal team when a date does not hold up. Have taken time out of programs before construction started, and can show how. You read a native schedule fluently and know which levers in design, permitting, power and procurement move a date. Have shaped delivery terms in development, lease or construction agreements, working with legal teams, and have led tendering and bid analysis. You understand how cost and schedule flow through to the investment case. Have a strong understanding of the end to end (dirt to delivery) data center development process to include entitlements and permitting, planning and supply chain, execution, commissioning, and handover. You are not an administrator but an active player in the arena comfortable making decisions without the need to consult across multiple external parties. You should understand the nuances of data center design and construction across EMEA markets- who the players are, how power and permitting differ, what contractual norms get in the way of speed of delivery, how teams can be incentivized to build and deliver faster than normal. Have built or scaled a team or function, including directing third-party advisers. In this role you will often be on an island and responsible for your own destiny. You will have free rein to develop your own approaches with the mission guidance being your only bounds. No one will be there to empower your efforts, you will create your own influence by building relationships and diving in at all phases to deliver success. You must thrive operating with ambiguity and have a willingness to own outcomes, knowing that the buck stops with you. It's a bonus if you: Understand AI/ML infrastructure requirements, including high-density power and advanced cooling systems Have had preconstruction or leadership positions (Preconstruction Manager, General Superintendent, Project Manager) within a GC, EPC or developer on hyperscale data center projects or in self performance of hyperscale data center development projects. Prioritize extreme ownership and have the ability to create winning cultures across diverse teams and job sites. Are deeply familiar with lease negotiations, construction contracts, or real estate development processes and have strategies to move those arrangements from traditionally transaction and risk managed arrangements to collaborative efforts that align incentives around accelerated delivery of facilities. Have secured long-lead equipment or manufacturing capacity ahead of a signed deal, including through frame agreements or early funding arrangements. Have run quantitative schedule risk analysis, or built parametric cost benchmarks across a portfolio of sites. Speak additional European languages. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: £1 — £1 GBP Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. items.title: Risk Specialist
items.location_text: Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Crypto Risk team's mission is to identify, assess, and mitigate risk across Robinhood Crypto's products, operations, and platforms, protecting customers and the firm as the business scales. We work to deliver an excellent end-customer experience while upholding the safety and soundness of the business, so Robinhood can keep expanding access to crypto responsibly. The team partners with engineering, product, compliance, crypto operations, and enterprise risk to keep a consistent view of risk across the organization. It's an exciting time to join as we launch new products and expand our crypto offering! As a Risk Specialist , you will support the execution of our crypto risk management program, partnering closely with Crypto Risk leadership to monitor, assess, and report on risk across the business. You will play a hands-on role in building and running operational risk management, with a particular focus on technical and product risk. Day to day, you will assess new products and business changes for risk, run risk and control self-assessments, and prepare reporting for governance forums. You will translate technical risks into clear terms for colleagues outside engineering and work closely with partner teams across the business. Your work will help us keep pace with new launches while protecting customers and the firm! This role is based in our New York, NY and Menlo Park, CA offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Facilitate Technical Risk Assessments (TRAs) and product risk assessments for new and existing crypto products, features, and business changes: document and assess risks and controls in collaboration with engineering and product owners. Analyze incident and issue data to identify recurring root causes, control weaknesses and systemic themes; lead or support retrospectives on material events and translate findings into actionable risk insights for leadership. Mature the operational loss tracking process, including loss definitions, intake, taxonomy, linkage to incidents and issues, and trend reporting. Manage the issue management lifecycle, from identification and prioritization through remediation tracking and closure, ensuring issues are handled and escalated appropriately. Perform and refresh Risk and Control Self-Assessments (RCSAs) and support Business Impact Analyses. Monitor, refine and develop key risk indicators (KRIs), and prepare risk reporting for governance forums, including risk committee and board materials and escalations.Translate technical risks into clear, actionable terms for non-engineering stakeholders. Translate technical risks into clear, actionable terms for non-engineering partners. Partner with engineering, product, compliance, crypto operations, and enterprise risk teams to maintain a consistent view of risk across the organization. What you bring 5+ years of experience in operational risk, enterprise risk management, or technology risk at a regulated financial services or crypto/fintech firm. (US-based ERM experience is preferred). Hands-on experience facilitating risk assessments (RCSA, technology or product risk assessments, process risk assessments), including working directly with business, product and engineering owners. Experience designing, running or materially contributing to business continuity or disaster recovery exercises, including scenario design, facilitation and after action reporting. Experience performing root cause analysis or thematic analysis across incidents, with the ability to identify patterns and systemic issues from operational data. Deep understanding of risk management methodologies, including risk taxonomies, control design, KRIs and issue management. Technical exposure and comfort working in a technical environment, with the ability to read engineering design documents and incident post mortems and extract the risk. A software engineering background is not required. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical colleagues and present risk findings to stakeholders across the organization. Detail oriented, with a proactive, independent approach to identifying and addressing risk. Bonus points Direct experience in the cryptocurrency industry, with familiarity with crypto products, custody, and blockchain fundamentals. A computer science or engineering degree, especially if you have built a career in risk, compliance, or another non-engineering role. Experience building or operating an operational loss event program Exposure to third party and vendor risk management, particularly for critical technology or custody providers. Familiarity with operational resilience regulatory expectations such as NYDFS 23 NYCRR 500, DORA or MiCA. Experience with governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) tools such as LogicGate or similar platforms. Analytical background with knowledge of SQL, Python, or a BI tool. What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career. Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching. Best-in-class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents. Lifestyle wallet — a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more. Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits. Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits. Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process. Base Pay Range: Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC) $94,000 — $110,000 USD Zone 2 (Denver, CO; Westlake, TX; Chicago, IL) $82,000 — $97,000 USD Zone 3 (Lake Mary, FL; Clearwater, FL; Gainesville, FL) $73,000 — $86,000 USD Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity. If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. AI Usage Disclosure: Robinhood uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruiting process. These tools enhance the efficiency and consistency of our hiring process; however, all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. Please review the Privacy Policy for your country of application.

items.location_text: Toronto, San Francisco, London, New York
items.description: WHO ARE WE? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! About the Role We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to help shape the future of our modelling products at Cohere. In this role, you will design intuitive experiences for complex workflows, working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and user needs. You'll collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and the ML team, owning the end-to-end design process and acting as a key stakeholder in prioritization and strategy decisions. You'll work on experiences that are defining how models are trained and deployed, and your contributions will directly impact real people in their daily work. What You'll Do - Own the design process end-to-end for your product area, identifying opportunities to improve user experience and drive product impact - Design intuitive, user-friendly experiences that balance technical complexity with accessibility and ease of use - Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders throughout the product development lifecycle - Conduct user research to understand needs, validate design decisions, and translate insights into actionable design improvements - Maintain a high craft and quality bar, ensuring every detail contributes to a cohesive and polished experience - Contribute to design systems and patterns that scale across the North platform - Partner with engineering to ensure designs are implemented with fidelity and make pragmatic tradeoffs when needed You're Likely a Good Fit If You Have - Product Design Experience: You have 4+ years experience designing digital products with a strong portfolio that demonstrates your process, systems thinking, and measurable impact on user outcomes. - AI and Agentic Fluency: You have a strong understanding of AI concepts and agentic systems, including how models reason, use tools, and orchestrate multi-step workflows. You stay current on AI trends and can design interactions that make complex agentic behaviours understandable and controllable for users. - Cross-Functional Partnership: You have a collaborative approach to product development, working closely with Product Managers to identify opportunities, with Engineers to navigate technical constraints and review implementations, and with stakeholders across the organization to align on solutions. - User-Centered Approach: You have a deep commitment to understanding user needs through research, data, and direct engagement. You drive research initiatives, translate findings into design decisions, and stay informed on industry trends that shape the product landscape. - Design Excellence: You have a meticulous attention to craft and detail. You're proficient in Figma, build scalable patterns and systems, and consistently elevate the quality of everything you touch. Bonus points for strong visual design skills in typography, layout, colour, and composition. - Communication Skills: Clear, proactive communication that keeps distributed teams aligned. You document decisions, articulate design rationale to diverse audiences, and create shared understanding across geographies and disciplines. FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role We build an ads engine that learns as it goes: brand book, taste, and what actually performs in every market. It plans, generates, localizes, launches and learns from ads across the major ad platforms, using ElevenLabs’ full audio and video stack. You’ll be a founding engineer for a product area of your own. There’s no PM and no handed-down spec. You’ll talk to users, decide what to build, and ship it across the stack, from data pipelines and agent tools to the UI. Early work could include feeding competitive intelligence into the engine’s weekly briefs or launching a new ad format. We’re looking for founders and founding engineers. You’d rather ship a rough v0 on Friday than a perfect design doc. Strong engineering is the minimum. What sets people apart is product judgment and ownership. Requirements - Has built and shipped a product end-to-end without anyone handing them a spec, ideally as a founder or one of the first engineers. - Strong full-stack product engineer (frontend- or backend-leaning is fine) who can build a pipeline, an agent tool and the UI - Builds with LLMs and agents pragmatically: tools, retrieval and evals, not model research. - Talks to users without being asked, and can say what they’d build first and why.
